name: avatar-row-item
description: Horizontal row: avatar on the left, name+meta in the middle, trailing icon on the right. Card-grounded (backgroundColor:var(--pw-color-card), borderRadius:8). The static/hand-written form of 'people list' widgets such as anniversaries/birthdays/welcome — this is the visual reference for repeater[layout=row].
provenPattern: Built early and documented later. When the layout="row" prop was added to the repeater block, the aim was to reproduce this pattern exactly.

knowledge.purpose: Person-list row: avatar on the left, name and meta in the middle, a trailing icon on the right — a single card-grounded row
useCases: The static form of people widgets such as anniversaries, birthdays and new joiners
Establishing a visual reference before binding data with repeater[layout=row]
Row layout in a directory or team list
antiPatterns: Cramming more than three facts into the row — the arrangement was measured for a name + one meta
Leaving the trailing icon decorative — an icon on the right promises an action; if it goes nowhere, remove it
Repeating this static row when the data is really a list — in that case use the repeater

placeholders.{{PERSON_NAME}}: avatar.props.name + text.props.content (isim iki yerde tekrar ediyor)
placeholders.{{PERSON_META}}: subtext — role/department, or a combined status+role string such as 'in 2 days · Project Manager'
